item_name: Rothco Security Patch With Hook Back
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Security Patch with Hook Back is designed to provide a clear and professional identifier for security personnel. Featuring a black background with bold white “Security” lettering, this patch ensures visibility and recognition. The hook back allows for easy attachment to various gear, including tactical jackets, vests, and operator baseball caps. Constructed with high-quality materials, this patch is built to last through rigorous use.
description: Rothco’s Security Patch with Hook Back is designed to provide a clear and professional identifier for security personnel. Featuring a black background with bold white “Security” lettering, this patch ensures visibility and recognition. The hook back allows for easy attachment to various gear, including tactical jackets, vests, and operator baseball caps. Constructed with high-quality materials, this patch is built to last through rigorous use. Available in 2 sizes, small (2 ½ inches X 5 ¾ inches) and large (4 inches X 10 ¾ inches), this patch set includes 1 of each size, offering versatility for different applications. Enhance your law enforcement or security uniform with Rothco’s durable and functional security patch.
